description: Found by the fz-go4.18.24 family-8 re-audit correctness lane (at dff9b4685; pre-existing from fz-go4.17.2, untouched by family 8). jobs/macro_runtime.rs:59 (build_macro_executable) synchronously calls world.complete_job(Job::BuildBackendProduct(root), effects) INLINE rather than via a wait/wake. By the owner's law (work runs only via waits/pull or changed-revision wakes) this is a smuggled push. If legitimate, DOCUMENT why in a comment + fact-engine.md (a sanctioned exception, like submit_root). If not, convert. Sequence AFTER arc-close (JobEffects::follow_up deletion) so the follow_up machinery is settled first. This is the northstar arc's next frontier beyond follow_up.
title: build_macro_executable synchronously completes BuildBackendProduct inline (non-follow_up push)
